decisions.reason: Harbor Quill is mentioned only as the current product and as part of a conditional user-count scenario; removing the Portugal geoblock does not change either product name.
The geoblock decision does not alter email magic-link authentication, dashboard access, or the supported non-crypto user group.
Removing a landing-page country geoblock does not change the unauthenticated access policy for public APIs.
The source decision does not affect the Brevo provider choice or transactional email delivery behavior.
The landing-page geoblock removal does not change SIWE authentication or the wallet-based flows it protects.

The occurrence of the word policy is incidental; the geoblock removal has no effect on the badge set, icons, or presentation rules.
